InterImage is seeking a Software Engineer to develop modern software applications and AI-enabled tools for mission-driven federal environments. The role supports integrating Generative AI, building backend services and automation workflows, and collaborating on modernization efforts for national security and operational effectiveness.
Enterprise Software
Software
No H1B

U.S. Citizen Only
Responsibilities
Support the design, development, testing, and deployment of modern software applications and AI-enabled tools
Assist with integrating Generative AI technologies into internal and customer-facing products
Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to prototype emerging capabilities
Develop APIs, automation workflows, and scalable backend services
Participate in Agile software development activities including sprint planning, standups, and code reviews
Research and evaluate new AI/ML frameworks, tools, and technologies
Contribute to cloud-native and containerized development environments
Help document technical solutions, system architecture, and development processes
Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on modernization and innovation

Experience or familiarity with some of the following is preferred: Git/GitLab/GitHub version control
Experience or familiarity with some of the following is preferred: Cloud environments such as AWS or Azure
Experience or familiarity with some of the following is preferred: Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized development
Experience or familiarity with some of the following is preferred: Frontend frameworks such as React or Angular
Experience or familiarity with some of the following is preferred: Data processing and automation scripting
Experience or familiarity with some of the following is preferred: AI/ML concepts or exposure to tools such as OpenAI APIs, LangChain, vector databases, or LLM integrations
Experience or familiarity with some of the following is preferred: CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices
